rationale: The implementation prevents the Autocomplete dropdown from auto-opening on keyboard focus (Tab) while maintaining search/toggle functionality on click, Enter, Space, and arrow keys. It also removes the duplicate tab stop on the dropdown button by setting tabIndex to -1. A comprehensive suite of 17 tests verifies these behaviors, and all quality gates compiled cleanly.

business_review.item: Prevent combobox from opening automatically on focus and streamline tab stops.
business_review.notes: Successfully implemented at the core Autocomplete component level, resolving accessibility violations and reducing chevron tab stops.

standards_review.notes: Types, linters, and unit tests compile and run flawlessly with zero warnings.
No security risks or external dependencies introduced.
